==> README.md <==
# Docker Compose deployment of a fleet

Run `docker compose up --build` from this directory, on one host. Each pool of the fleet has one hub, the service named for the pool, and a service for each segment of its class in its layout, named `<pool>_<segment>`. A pool's hub and segments take the pool's settings from `GDL_POOL__*` variables, and a segment finds its own pool's hub through `GDL_HUB__HOST`.

A segment starts once its own pool's hub is healthy, and waits for nothing else. A hub's health check is its own liveness. Nothing waits for a pool's health, or for another pool: a parent pool's health answers 503 until its children are ready, so a wait on it would deadlock a fleet that starts together.

A pool's hub must never run as two at once: a pool's record has one writer, its hub. Each hub's service names its container, so Compose refuses to scale it. Container names are global on the Docker host, so a host runs one copy of this bundle at a time. Compose's default recreate stops the old container before it starts the new one, so `docker compose up` after a change replaces a hub without two running at once.

Each pool's hub publishes its record under the `relay` directory backend: a child pool's hub reports it to its parent pool's hub (`GDL_POOL__PARENT_HUB`), and the parent's hub holds its children's records. The hubs share no volume, so the pools can run on several hosts, if each hub reaches its parent's hub by the name the bundle gives it. Each parent pool's hub keeps its children's records in a volume of its own, `<pool>-state`, mounted at `/var/lib/gdl-hub` (`GDL_POOL__STATE_DIR`), so it still holds them after it restarts, a silent child's included, until the child withdraws. `docker compose down --volumes` removes them. A parent's hub on another host needs that volume, or a directory of its own, on its host.

Each image is built once, from one Dockerfile per layout and segment, and every pool of that layout and class runs it. A segment's image is named for its package (`<graph>-<segment>`, or `<graph>-<layout>-<segment>` for a spec of several layouts), and a hub's is `<graph>-hub`, tagged with its layout for a spec of several.

Each segment takes its roster from its pool's hub when it starts: the loaded instances of every segment of its class, at least `min_replicas` of each (one by default). An instance that starts later joins, so `docker compose up --scale <pool>_<segment>=N` adds instances of a segment that publishes no host port. A segment that publishes a host port it names (`HOST:CONTAINER`) runs in one pool; one whose host ports Docker chooses (`CONTAINER`, or host port 0) runs in several. An instance that is stopped retires: the others stop routing to it, and it leaves once it has drained. `cargo gdl k8s` writes a fleet's Kubernetes objects instead; srt-slurm is not generated.

{
  "services": {
    "global-us": {
      "build": {
        "context": ".",
        "dockerfile": "hub/Dockerfile"
      },
      "container_name": "api-global-us",
      "environment": {
        "GDL_POOL__CLASS": "global",
        "GDL_POOL__DIRECTORY": "relay",
        "GDL_POOL__HUB": "global-us:1337",
        "GDL_POOL__NAME": "global-us",
        "GDL_POOL__READY__FRONT": "1",
        "GDL_POOL__REGION": "us-east-1",
        "GDL_POOL__STATE_DIR": "/var/lib/gdl-hub",
        "GDL_POOL__SUMMARY_MS": "10000"
      },
      "healthcheck": {
        "interval": "2s",
        "retries": 30,
        "test": [
          "CMD",
          "/usr/local/bin/segment",
          "--healthcheck"
        ],
        "timeout": "2s"
      },
      "image": "api-hub",
      "volumes": [
        "global-us-state:/var/lib/gdl-hub"
      ]

// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Generated from the graph file `api.gdl`.

//! The contract of graph `api`: its graph, with each message named
//! by the full path of the type it resolved to.

gdl_runtime::graph! {
    name = "api", schema = 1;
    source   Http: ::api_frontend::Prompt -> stream ::api_frontend::Chunk;
    sink     Engine: ::api_frontend::Prompt -> stream ::api_frontend::Chunk;
    topology: Http => Engine;
}

      },

        "name": "Engine",
        "role": "sink",
        "binding": "engine"
      }

      {
        "outer": "Http",
        "forward": [],
        "inner": "Engine",
        "backward": [],
        "forward_types": [
          {
            "name": ":: api_frontend :: Prompt",
            "wire": true,
            "encoding": "msgpack"
          }
        ],
        "backward_types": [
          {
            "name": ":: api_frontend :: Chunk",
            "wire": true,
            "encoding": "msgpack"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },

    "segment": {
      "engine": {
        "nodes": [
          "Engine"
        ]
      },

        "nodes": [
          "Http"

      }

        "segments": [
          "front"
        ]
      },
      "model_x": {
        "segments": [
          "engine"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}

==> engine/src/lib.rs <==
// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Segment `engine` of graph `api`, hosting `Engine`.
//!
//! [`start`] deploys it inside a program; the `api-engine` binary deploys it on
//! its own, through [`Binary`].

gdl_runtime::segment! {
    contract: ::api_contract;
    package: "api-engine";
    segment: "engine";
    segments: ["engine", "front"];
    placement: r#"[segment.engine]
nodes = ["Engine"]

[segment.front]
nodes = ["Http"]

[class.global]
segments = ["front"]

[class.model_x]
segments = ["engine"]
"#;
    graph_config: "[Engine]\n\n[Http]\nenabled_anthropic = true\nenabled_chat = true\nenabled_responses = true\n\n[Http_anthropic_op]\n\n[Http_chat_b0]\n\n[Http_chat_f0]\n\n[Http_responses_op]\n";
    roots: [Http];
    crossings: [
        crosses Http_to_Engine = Engine SinkDecl Req;
        crosses Engine_to_Http = Http SourceDecl Item;
    ];
    feeds: [];
    nodes: [
        Engine engine = ::api_frontend::Echo;
    ];
    policies: [];
    serve: none;
}

==> engine/src/main.rs <==
// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Runs segment `engine` on its own.
//!
//! Usage: `api-engine <config.toml> [override.toml ...]`. Files merge in argument
//! order, then `GDL_` environment variables, with `__` between nested keys
//! (`GDL_RUNTIME__ADMISSION_LIMIT=64`). `api-engine --healthcheck <config.toml> ...`
//! asks a running instance's health probe instead, as a container health check
//! does. Log events go to stderr, at the level `RUST_LOG` sets (`warn` by default).
//! The settings are:
//!
//! ```toml
//! listen = "127.0.0.1:0"  # this instance's address; under a hub, an unspecified one advertises what HOSTNAME resolves to
//! roster = "/run/roster"  # a directory every instance shares, fresh for each deployment
//! # [hub]                 # or the discovery hub: exactly one of the two
//! # host = "hub"          # its host; public_port, control_port, and heartbeat_ms (5000) are optional
//! rendezvous_ms = 30000   # optional: how long to wait for the other instances
//! hub_wait_ms = 300000    # optional, with a hub: how long the start waits for the hub to answer
//! [instances]             # optional, with a roster: instances per segment, 1 by default
//! [min_replicas]          # optional, with a hub: loaded instances per segment to wait for, 1 by default
//! [runtime]               # optional: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig
//! [system]                # optional: the live and health probes, off unless port is set (DYN_SYSTEM_PORT)
//! [node.Engine]           # optional: Engine's Build::Config
//! ```
//! Graph-affecting values must match the built graph.

fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    let filter = tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::builder()
        .with_default_directive(tracing_subscriber::filter::LevelFilter::WARN.into())
        .from_env_lossy();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(filter)
        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)
        .with_ansi(false)
        .init();
    gdl_runtime::segment_main::<api_engine::Binary>()
}

// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Segment `front` of graph `api`, hosting `Http`.
//!
//! [`start`] deploys it inside a program; the `api-front` binary deploys it on
//! its own, through [`Binary`].

gdl_runtime::segment! {
    contract: ::api_contract;
    package: "api-front";
    segment: "front";
    segments: ["engine", "front"];
    placement: r#"[segment.engine]
nodes = ["Engine"]

[segment.front]
nodes = ["Http"]

[class.global]
segments = ["front"]

[class.model_x]
segments = ["engine"]
"#;
    graph_config: "[Engine]\n\n[Http]\nenabled_anthropic = true\nenabled_chat = true\nenabled_responses = true\n\n[Http_anthropic_op]\n\n[Http_chat_b0]\n\n[Http_chat_f0]\n\n[Http_responses_op]\n";
    roots: [Http];
    crossings: [
        crosses Http_to_Engine = Engine SinkDecl Req;
        crosses Engine_to_Http = Http SourceDecl Item;
    ];
    feeds: [];
    nodes: [];
    policies: [];
    serve: service {
        frontend: Http = ::api_frontend::ApiFrontend;
        clients: ::api_frontend::ApiClients;
        adapters: [
            "Http_chat_f0" entry_487474705f636861745f6630 = ::api_frontend::ExtractChat;
            "Http_chat_b0" entry_487474705f636861745f6230 = ::api_frontend::FormatChat;
            "Http_responses_op" entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70 = ::api_frontend::ResponsesAdapter;
            "Http_anthropic_op" entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70 = ::api_frontend::AnthropicAdapter;
        ];
        pipelines: [
            pipeline_48747470 = 0;
        ];
        entries: [
            chat = gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new((std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f636861745f6630), ()), gdl_runtime::gdl::Join::new(pipeline_48747470.clone()), (std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f636861745f6230), ()));
            responses = gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new((), gdl_runtime::gdl::OperatorStage::new(std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70), gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new((), gdl_runtime::gdl::Join::new(pipeline_48747470.clone()), ())), ());
            anthropic = gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new((), gdl_runtime::gdl::OperatorStage::new(std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70), gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new((), gdl_runtime::gdl::Join::new(pipeline_48747470.clone()), ())), ());
        ];
    };
}

==> front/src/main.rs <==
// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Runs segment `front` on its own.
//!
//! Usage: `api-front <config.toml> [override.toml ...]`. Files merge in argument
//! order, then `GDL_` environment variables, with `__` between nested keys
//! (`GDL_RUNTIME__ADMISSION_LIMIT=64`). `api-front --healthcheck <config.toml> ...`
//! asks a running instance's health probe instead, as a container health check
//! does. Log events go to stderr, at the level `RUST_LOG` sets (`warn` by default).
//! The settings are:
//!
//! ```toml
//! listen = "127.0.0.1:0"       # this instance's address; under a hub, an unspecified one advertises what HOSTNAME resolves to
//! roster = "/run/roster"       # a directory every instance shares, fresh for each deployment
//! # [hub]                      # or the discovery hub: exactly one of the two
//! # host = "hub"               # its host; public_port, control_port, and heartbeat_ms (5000) are optional
//! rendezvous_ms = 30000        # optional: how long to wait for the other instances
//! hub_wait_ms = 300000         # optional, with a hub: how long the start waits for the hub to answer
//! [instances]                  # optional, with a roster: instances per segment, 1 by default
//! [min_replicas]               # optional, with a hub: loaded instances per segment to wait for, 1 by default
//! [runtime]                    # optional: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig
//! [system]                     # optional: the live and health probes, off unless port is set (DYN_SYSTEM_PORT)
//! [frontend]                   # the source frontend's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_chat_f0]       # optional: entry adapter Http_chat_f0's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_chat_b0]       # optional: entry adapter Http_chat_b0's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_responses_op]  # optional: entry adapter Http_responses_op's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_anthropic_op]  # optional: entry adapter Http_anthropic_op's Build::Config
//! ```
//! Graph-affecting values must match the built graph.
//!
//! The source frontend serves once its segments are ready, and drains on
//! SIGINT or SIGTERM.

fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    let filter = tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::builder()
        .with_default_directive(tracing_subscriber::filter::LevelFilter::WARN.into())
        .from_env_lossy();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(filter)
        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)
        .with_ansi(false)
        .init();
    gdl_runtime::segment_main::<api_front::Binary>()
}

==> hub/Dockerfile <==
# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit
FROM rust:1.93.1-slim-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
ENV CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build
RUN cargo install --git '<url>' --rev '<rev>' --locked --root /build-tools gdl-hub && mkdir -p /build-tools/state/gdl-hub && chmod 1777 /build-tools/state/gdl-hub
FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /build-tools/bin/gdl-hub /usr/local/bin/segment
COPY ["./deployment.json", "/etc/gdl/config"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/segment","/etc/gdl/config"]
COPY --from=build /build-tools/state/ /var/lib/
